standard.name: ASTM E2581
standard.title: Shearography of Polymer Matrix Composites and Sandwich Core Materials in Aerospace Applications

scope.method: Laser shearography NDT for polymer matrix composites and sandwich core materials.
scope.acceptanceCriteria: Does not specify accept/reject criteria and is not a service approval method.

equipment.camera: Laser shearography camera with demonstrated ability to detect maximum allowable defect size/depth in similar material and structure.
equipment.imageProcessing: Computer captures images, converts to digital format, applies signal processing, and supports adjacent image mosaics.
equipment.fixture: Rigid fixture minimizes relative motion between camera and article to prevent image decorrelation.

procedureOptions: heat then capture then wait then capture
thermal.repeatability: Requires precise timing of heat and wait parameters.

pressure.biasPressure: Usually 0.1 to 1.0 percent of working pressure for pressure vessels.
pressure.cycleDelta: Approximately 0.5 percent of working pressure, or limited by decorrelation.

stressingMethods.acousticVibration: Air-coupled acoustic driver introduces focused acoustic pressure wave.
stressingMethods.mechanicalVibration: Piezoelectric actuator coupled by mechanical or vacuum attachment.

general: Place camera at optimal field of view and focus.
Offset view if required to avoid laser saturation.
Calibrate image scale with known point spacing.
Capture unstressed and stressed images and process phase map shearogram.

qualificationAndSafety.facility: NDE facilities qualified per ASTM E543 when contractually specified.
qualificationAndSafety.laserSafety: Control laser hazard according to applicable laser safety classifications and regulations.
qualificationAndSafety.acousticNoise: Evaluate acoustic/mechanical vibration noise exposure and use minimum required source levels.

precisionBiasDocumentation.quantitativeCalibration: Requires pixel/mm or pixel/in image scale and shear vector calibration.
precisionBiasDocumentation.repeatability: Use repeated scans of known features with similar loading/deformation.

systemUse.primaryUse: Reference standard for composite shearography workflows.
systemUse.autoFillImpact: Not a UT scan-parameter driver; keep separate from ultrasonic technique sheet defaults.
